title: Image-backed masked and unmasked 3D Gaussian refinement for six Janelle Gaussian2D fields
question: For each of the six Gaussian2D folders explicitly selected by the owner in Janelle frame_00008, how do masked and unmasked executions of the same compact-field lift plus standard image-supervised 3DGS compare in validation convergence, final held-out Janelle image quality, silhouette leakage, runtime, memory, and final Gaussian capacity?
hypothesis: Using the source-backed foreground masks in both compact-field placement and RGB refinement will improve held-out foreground PSNR, crop SSIM, alpha IoU, and exterior leakage relative to an otherwise matched unmasked execution, while folders with higher-capacity or boundary-aware 2D fields will provide an initialization that reaches a fixed validation-quality threshold sooner; any such result is expected to be dataset-specific and may trade full-canvas background fidelity for foreground quality.
claim_boundary: Development-only, single-frame evidence over six pre-existing Gaussian2D decompositions of the same 26-camera Janelle capture. Every folder is an independent experiment unit with identical split, algorithm, seed schedule, and RGB source. The run may compare masked versus unmasked end-to-end behavior and descriptive differences among those six inputs. It cannot establish cross-scene generality, state-of-the-art quality, GPS-Gaussian reproduction, real-time performance, production-default suitability, or that a deterministic bounded field carrier preserves every low-mass source component. Held-out test views are final-reporting only.

stages.label: Input alignment and split guard
stages.purpose: Verify the selected compact manifest, full source component counts, calibrated camera ids, exact Janelle JPG/mask hashes, and optimizer/validation/test partition before outcomes are accessible.

stages.label: Support-aware probabilistic field lift
stages.purpose: Lift only optimizer-camera 2D fields into a persistent 3D Gaussian initialization; the masked arm uses source-backed packed alpha and the unmasked arm ignores alpha.

stages.label: Standard image-backed 3DGS refinement
stages.purpose: Optimize the lifted model with the repository Trainer and gsplat using only optimizer-camera Janelle RGB; apply external Janelle masks only in the masked arm.

stages.label: Fixed validation convergence reporting
stages.purpose: At frozen checkpoints, evaluate the untouched validation cameras for quality-versus-step and quality-versus-wall-time curves without selection or early stopping.

stages.label: Final held-out Janelle image evaluation
stages.purpose: After optimization is complete, open the three test views once for full/foreground image quality and silhouette metrics; test results cannot alter any model.

stages.label: Per-folder report and orbit presentation
stages.purpose: Save calibrated previews, initial/final models, a masked/unmasked comparison manifest, and one canonical child index page for each Gaussian2D folder.

comparators.label: Masked lift and RGB refinement
comparators.purpose: Uses each compact view's source-backed alpha in field placement and the matching Janelle PNG mask in image refinement.

comparators.label: Unmasked lift and RGB refinement
comparators.purpose: Ignores alpha in field placement and trains against the full Janelle RGB canvas; evaluation still retains masks for a matched foreground readout.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: mean over the three fixed held-out views per cell; report every seed and the per-folder median

primary_metrics.label: Held-out full-canvas PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: mean over the three fixed held-out views per cell; report every seed and the per-folder median

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground-crop SSIM
primary_metrics.aggregation: mean over the three fixed held-out views per cell; report every seed and the per-folder median

primary_metrics.label: Held-out alpha IoU
primary_metrics.aggregation: mean over the three fixed held-out views per cell; report every seed and the per-folder median

primary_metrics.label: Held-out exterior alpha leakage
primary_metrics.aggregation: mean over the three fixed held-out views per cell; report every seed and the per-folder median

primary_metrics.label: Validation foreground PSNR area under native optimizer-time curve
primary_metrics.aggregation: trapezoidal time-normalized AUC over the observer-excluded native optimizer clock at frozen validation checkpoints, then per-folder median over seeds

primary_metrics.label: Native RGB optimizer wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: Trainer native elapsed from first optimizer step through final synchronized step, excluding external validation observers; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: Field-lift cell wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: measured field-lift stage wall interval per fresh cell; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: External validation observer wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: initial plus checkpoint snapshot/render observer wall time, excluded from the native optimizer clock; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: Worker-start to frozen endpoint wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: fresh worker start through synchronized final PLY/NPZ save before held-out access; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: Input-open to frozen endpoint wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: post-CUDA-reset compact-input open through synchronized final PLY/NPZ save before held-out access; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: Peak CUDA allocated
primary_metrics.aggregation: per-cell torch peak; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: Peak CUDA reserved
primary_metrics.aggregation: per-cell torch reserved-memory peak over input-open to frozen endpoint; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: Peak process RSS
primary_metrics.aggregation: fresh worker ru_maxrss sampled at the frozen endpoint; per-folder median over three seeds

primary_metrics.label: Final Gaussian count
primary_metrics.aggregation: per-cell endpoint; per-folder median over three seeds

resource_protocol.scope: One fresh process per dataset/seed/mask arm. Process-owned CUDA peaks reset immediately before compact-field access and freeze after the synchronized final PLY/NPZ save. Total cell wall covers that same input-open-to-endpoint interval. Native optimizer elapsed excludes the initial validation render, checkpoint snapshot construction, every validation render, held-out evaluation, serialization after the endpoint, previews, reports, and viewers.
resource_protocol.aggregation: one frozen seed per measured repeat; retain every raw cell and report per-folder medians without pooling the six folders

field_lift.component_count_policy: load and seal every source component; if a view exceeds 2048 components, use the deterministic receipted carrier only for the CPU field lift

frozen_configuration.selection_policy: No validation or held-out metric changes the endpoint, hyperparameters, arm, seed, or representative model. Seed 80601 is selected prospectively for preview and orbit presentation only.
frozen_configuration.aggregation_policy: Each folder page is the scientific result unit. Root metrics are navigation-only medians of the twelve folder-by-arm medians and must not be used to rank folders or assert a pooled treatment effect.
frozen_configuration.failure_policy: A failed cell writes a structured receipt and does not receive imputed quality or timing values. Continue only to independent cells; the root is incomplete unless all 36 measured cells succeed.
